_about: Hand-written, client-style visit transcripts (synthetic, no real person) with the answer a careful coder would give. Written for the STARTER catalog (J02.9 M54.50 N39.0 I10 E11.9 R05.9 M25.569; 97110 71046 81002 96372). 'reason' lists the acceptable routing reasons. route 'auto' means: with the policy on and no sampling, every check passes. 'cpt' is the E/M code (the first procedure code when only therapy is billed).

cases.name: soap_htn
lines: S: 58 y/o established patient here for BP follow-up. Started lisinopril since March. Mild headaches in the morning, also some dizziness, worse when standing. Denies chest pain.
O: BP 152/94. Heart RRR. Lungs clear to auscultation. Abdomen soft.
A: Hypertension, not at goal.
P: Increase lisinopril to 20 mg, recheck in 4 weeks.
Signed electronically by Dr. Demo Provider.

cases.name: dialogue_uti_new
lines: Dr: Hello, is this your first time at our clinic?
Pt: Yes, I'm a new patient.
Dr: What's going on?
Pt: It burns when I urinate, started two days ago, and I feel the need to go often. Maybe a 4 out of 10.
Dr: Any fever?
Pt: No fever.
Dr: Abdomen is soft, mild suprapubic tenderness.
Assessment: UTI.
Plan: Send urinalysis, start antibiotics, follow up if no better in 3 days.
Signed electronically by Dr. Demo Provider.
